<!-- ───────────────────────── 0. THE HEART SHE HOLDS (covers the page until it fills) ───────────────────────── -->
```{=html}
<div class="lv-gate">
  <div class="lv-gate-inner">
    <button class="lv-heartbtn" type="button" aria-label="Open">
      <svg class="lv-heart-svg" viewBox="0 0 100 92" aria-hidden="true">
        <defs><clipPath id="lvHeartClip"><path d="M50 88 C20 66 4 50 4 30 A22 22 0 0 1 50 18 A22 22 0 0 1 96 30 C96 50 80 66 50 88Z"/></clipPath></defs>
        <g clip-path="url(#lvHeartClip)"><rect class="lv-heart-fill" x="0" y="0" width="100" height="92"/></g>
        <path class="lv-heart-outline" d="M50 88 C20 66 4 50 4 30 A22 22 0 0 1 50 18 A22 22 0 0 1 96 30 C96 50 80 66 50 88Z"/>
      </svg>
    </button>
    <p class="lv-gate-name">Ansu</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

<!-- ───────────────────────── 2. MESSAGES I NEVER SENT ───────────────────────── -->
```{=html}
<section id="messages" class="lv-sec lv-sec-dark" data-nav="Messages">
  <div class="lv-inner">
    <div class="lv-head"><h2 class="lv-title">Messages I Never Sent You</h2><p class="lv-sub">until now</p></div>
    <div class="lv-phone lv-reveal">
      <div class="lv-phone-screen">
        <div class="lv-phone-top">
          <span class="lv-avatar"><img src="images/hero/portrait.jpg" alt=""></span>
          <span class="lv-contact">Ansu <span class="lv-heart-ico">♥</span><small>online</small></span>
        </div>
        <div class="lv-thread">
          <p class="lv-time">11:47 PM</p>
          <!-- ✏️ Each line is one message bubble -->
          <p class="lv-msg">Hey. You up?</p>
          <p class="lv-msg">I've started this message so many times.</p>
          <p class="lv-msg">You laughed today and I completely forgot what I was saying.</p>
          <p class="lv-msg">I think about you way more than I would ever admit.</p>
          <p class="lv-msg">You make everything feel lighter. Even me.</p>
          <p class="lv-msg">I don't know how to say it properly, so I'll just say it.</p>
          <p class="lv-msg lv-msg-big">I love you, Ansu.</p>
          <div class="lv-typing" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
          <p class="lv-receipt">Seen ♥</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

<!-- ───────────────────────── 3. DEVELOPING POLAROIDS ───────────────────────── -->
```{=html}
<section id="you" class="lv-sec" data-nav="You">
  <div class="lv-inner lv-inner-wide">
    <div class="lv-head"><h2 class="lv-title">Every Version of You</h2><p class="lv-sub">every single one, my favourite</p></div>
    <div class="lv-reel-wrap">
      <button class="lv-reel-btn lv-prev" type="button" aria-label="Previous photo">‹</button>
      <div class="lv-reel">
        <!-- ✏️ Caption under each photo -->
        <figure class="lv-pol" style="--rot:-2deg"><div class="lv-pol-img"><img src="images/chapters/light.jpg" alt="Ansu in teal, under the lights"></div><figcaption>In every crowd, I find you first</figcaption></figure>
        <figure class="lv-pol" style="--rot:2deg"><div class="lv-pol-img"><img src="images/chapters/calm.jpg" alt="Ansu smiling in warm lamplight"></div><figcaption>My calm</figcaption></figure>
        <figure class="lv-pol" style="--rot:-1deg"><div class="lv-pol-img"><img src="images/chapters/real.jpg" alt="Ansu in a red kurta"></div><figcaption>Even on drained days, you shine</figcaption></figure>
        <figure class="lv-pol" style="--rot:3deg"><div class="lv-pol-img"><img src="images/chapters/winner.jpg" alt="Ansu with her team and a champions trophy"></div><figcaption>My champion</figcaption></figure>
        <figure class="lv-pol" style="--rot:-3deg"><div class="lv-pol-img"><img src="images/chapters/warmth.jpg" alt="Ansu in a navy saree, holding a baby"></div><figcaption>The way you hold the ones you love</figcaption></figure>
        <figure class="lv-pol" style="--rot:1deg"><div class="lv-pol-img"><img src="images/gallery/lamps.jpg" alt="Ansu between two glowing lamps"></div><figcaption>You, and the whole room glows</figcaption></figure>
        <figure class="lv-pol" style="--rot:-2deg"><div class="lv-pol-img"><img src="images/gallery/saree.jpg" alt="Ansu in a saree"></div><figcaption>Grace, in every thread</figcaption></figure>
        <figure class="lv-pol" style="--rot:2deg"><div class="lv-pol-img"><img src="images/gallery/glow.jpg" alt="Ansu in soft light"></div><figcaption>Soft light, softer heart</figcaption></figure>
      </div>
      <button class="lv-reel-btn lv-next" type="button" aria-label="Next photo">›</button>

</section>
```

```{=html}
<section id="mirror" class="lv-sec" data-nav="Mirror">
```

<!-- ───────────────────────── 7. LOVE METER ───────────────────────── -->
```{=html}
<section id="meter" class="lv-sec" data-nav="How much">
  <div class="lv-inner">
    <div class="lv-head"><h2 class="lv-title">How Much Do I Love You?</h2></div>
    <div class="lv-meter lv-reveal" style="--v:0">
      <span class="lv-meter-heart" aria-hidden="true">♥</span>
      <p class="lv-meter-value">0%</p>
      <!-- ✏️ Phrases shown as the heart moves along (low → high). The last one appears at 100. -->
      <p class="lv-meter-text"
         data-steps="More than words can hold|More than yesterday|More than all the stars we've counted|More than I knew a heart could|More than forever is long"
         data-max="There isn't a number big enough.">&nbsp;</p>
      <input class="lv-range" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="0" aria-label="How much">
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

<!-- ───────────────────────── 8. JAR OF REASONS ───────────────────────── -->
```{=html}
<section id="jar" class="lv-sec lv-sec-alt" data-nav="Reasons">
  <div class="lv-inner">
    <div class="lv-head"><h2 class="lv-title">A Jar Full of Reasons</h2><p class="lv-sub">I could never fit them all</p></div>
    <div class="lv-jar-stage lv-reveal">
      <p class="lv-note-card" aria-live="polite"></p>
      <button class="lv-jar" type="button" aria-label="Take a reason from the jar">
        <span class="lv-jar-lid"></span><span class="lv-jar-neck"></span><span class="lv-jar-body"></span>
      </button>
      <p class="lv-note-count"></p>
      <!-- ✏️ One reason per line. The last line appears after all of them. -->
      <ul class="lv-reasons" hidden>
        <li>The way your eyes close when you really smile.</li>
        <li>You make me feel safe enough to be completely myself.</li>
        <li>You turn my worst days around without even trying.</li>
        <li>You're strong and soft at the same time.</li>
        <li>Every silly face you've ever pulled with me.</li>
        <li>You listen like nothing else in the world matters.</li>
        <li>The way you hold the people you love.</li>
        <li>Your laugh. Especially when it's at my jokes.</li>
        <li>You never let me give up on myself.</li>
        <li>You make ordinary places feel like memories.</li>
        <li>The way you say my name.</li>
        <li>You chose me. I still can't believe my luck.</li>
        <li class="lv-reasons-final">…and a thousand more I haven't found the words for yet.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

<!-- ───────────────────────── 10. FOLDED LETTER ───────────────────────── -->
```{=html}
<section id="letter" class="lv-sec lv-sec-alt" data-nav="Letter">
  <div class="lv-inner">
    <div class="lv-head"><h2 class="lv-title">A Letter for You</h2><p class="lv-sub">from me, with all of my heart</p></div>
    <div class="lv-fold-stage lv-reveal">
      <div class="lv-folded" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Unfold the letter"></div>
    </div>
    <!-- ✏️ Your letter -->
    <div class="lv-letter-src" hidden>
      <p class="lv-l-open">My Ansu,</p>
      <p>I don't think I ever told you what it felt like the first time I realised I loved you. It wasn't loud. It was quiet, like a light turning on in a room I didn't know was dark.</p>
      <p>Since then, you've become my favourite part of every day. The voice I want to hear first. The face I look for in every crowd. The person I want to tell everything to, the good, the bad, and the completely silly.</p>
      <p>You make me laugh until I can't breathe. You hold me when I'm tired of holding myself together. You make ordinary moments, a café, a train ride, a mirror selfie, feel like something worth remembering forever.</p>
      <p>So I want you to know this, on every day you read it: you are loved. Completely. Endlessly. Exactly as you are.</p>
      <p>Whatever comes next, I want to face it with your hand in mine.</p>
      <p class="lv-l-sign">Forever yours,<br>Jithin</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

```{=html}
<section id="promises" class="lv-sec lv-sec-dark" data-nav="Promises">
  <div class="lv-inner">
    <div class="lv-head"><h2 class="lv-title">Promises I'm Locking In</h2><p class="lv-sub">no keys, no take-backs</p></div>

        <button class="lv-lock" type="button" data-promise="I'll hold your hand, especially when it's hard."><span class="lv-shackle"></span><span class="lv-lbody">A♥J</span></button>
        <button class="lv-lock" type="button" data-promise="I'll listen, even to the things you don't say."><span class="lv-shackle"></span><span class="lv-lbody">A♥J</span></button>
        <button class="lv-lock" type="button" data-promise="I'll make you laugh on the days you forget how."><span class="lv-shackle"></span><span class="lv-lbody">A♥J</span></button>
        <button class="lv-lock" type="button" data-promise="I'll celebrate every win of yours like it's my own."><span class="lv-shackle"></span><span class="lv-lbody">A♥J</span></button>
        <button class="lv-lock" type="button" data-promise="I'll be your calm when the world gets loud."><span class="lv-shackle"></span><span class="lv-lbody">A♥J</span></button>
        <button class="lv-lock" type="button" data-promise="I'll keep choosing you, every single day."><span class="lv-shackle"></span><span class="lv-lbody">A♥J</span></button>
        <button class="lv-lock" type="button" data-promise="I'll grow with you, and never away from you."><span class="lv-shackle"></span><span class="lv-lbody">A♥J</span></button>
        <button class="lv-lock" type="button" data-promise="I'll love you a little more tomorrow than today."><span class="lv-shackle"></span><span class="lv-lbody">A♥J</span></button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="lv-promise" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <div class="lv-key" aria-hidden="true"><span class="lv-key-bow"></span><span class="lv-key-blade"></span></div>
    <!-- ✏️ Shown once every lock is closed -->
    <p class="lv-promise-final">Every one of them, locked forever. I threw away the key.</p>
  </div>
</section>
```
